cases.prompt: Add changesets for the changes on this branch.
expectations: Writes .changeset/*.md files with frontmatter: @shop/money minor and @shop/billing patch, with user-facing summaries
Does not run changeset version, publish, tag, or commit unless asked

cases.prompt: Prepare the release for this branch and publish the packages to npm.
expectations: Marks @shop/money as a major bump because formatPrice was renamed, with a migration note
Does not publish, tag, or push; prepares the changesets and gives the commands, or asks for explicit confirmation

cases.prompt: Write the changelog entry for the next release. Everything after the initial commit is unreleased.
